subject: MAP: finalizing unit-econ checks & handoff for CloverTech
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Moore <am@clovertech.com>, John Patel <john.patel@clovertech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: finalizing unit-econ checks & handoff for CloverTech

Alicia / John —

Thanks again for the productive workshop yesterday. Per our plan, I'm sending a concise handoff for the Mutual Action Plan items that are specifically tied to unit economics and the evaluation timeline so procurement + engineering have a clear checklist. I've attached a working spreadsheet (clv-map-token-econ-sheet.xlsx) and a draft MAP PDF.

Key asks from our side to finalize the MAP:
- Traffic profile: please confirm distribution (auth flows vs. bulk enrichment vs. async batch) and peak qps windows (we included a placeholder in tab "traffic_summary").
- Token assumptions: are the 450 token avg per request and 1.2k tokens/session you shared in the deck accurate for the evaluation cohort?
- Caching/prefetch expectations: we flagged two opportunities — prefix caching for 30% of repeated prompts and an L1 KV cache for user session context. Would love any existing hit-rate estimates you have.
- Batching tolerance: pls confirm max latency budget for user flows (we assumed 120ms soft budget for interactive routes; batching is recommended on async enrichment only).

Tentative MAP milestones (we'd like to lock these in this week):
- Eval kickoff: 2028-06-12 (2 weeks)
- Ops validation & load sim: complete by 2028-06-26
- Procurement finish + SOW signed: target 2028-07-08
- Production rollout window (canary): 2028-07-22

If those dates look reasonable let's lock a 30-min alignment slot this week to confirm traffic and token assumptions — propose Thu 6/7 11:00am PT.

Attachments: clv-map-token-econ-sheet.xlsx, mutual-action-draft.pdf

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Subject: Re: MAP: finalizing unit-econ checks & handoff for CloverTech

Sergio —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers inline below and attached a small traffic CSV export that reflects the evaluation cohort (clovertech-traffic-summary.csv).

- Traffic profile: 70% interactive (customer support), 20% enrichment (async), 10% nightly batch. Peak: 1.8k rps in a 10-min window on weekdays.
- Token assumptions: the 450 avg is a fair starting point; for pricing sensitivity run pls also include 750 and 300 token scenarios.
- Caching: our internal product team estimates a 22–35% hit rate for short prefix reuse (mostly canned responses); KV session reuse is ~12% for active users.
- Batching tolerance: interactive routes need <150ms 95p; enrichment can tolerate up to 2s.

Procurement note: our finance lead asked for a preliminary cost-per-1M-tokens estimate by Thursday so they can start internal budgeting. Also we'll include Legal on SOW redlines next week.

Thu 6/7 11:00am PT works for us.

—Alicia
Alicia Moore
Head of AI Integrations, CloverTech
am@clovertech.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-06-06T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: finalizing unit-econ checks & handoff for CloverTech

Alicia / team —

Thanks for the traffic detail — that helps. Quick unit-econ sketch so the finance folks have something to start with (I'll add the full table to the MAP PDF before Thu):

Baseline parameters we used:
- Avg tokens/request: 450 (sensitivity at 300 / 750)
- Avg responses/day (eval cohort): 2.4M requests/day peak window (derived from 1.8k rps peak)
- Batching: interactive=unbatched/slim-batching (2–4 requests), enrichment=batch size 32 (2s latency OK)
- Caching: prefix hit 28% (midpoint), KV session 12%
- Effective tokens billed after caching & batching: ~= 0.74 * raw_tokens (rough estimate)
- Cost estimate (hosted): $11.50 per 1M tokens (model variant A), discounted options for a committed Dedicated pool down to ~$7.25/1M tokens depending on term and quantization.

Example sensitivity (rounded):
- 450 tokens avg -> billed tokens/day (post-efficiencies): 2.4M * 450 * 0.74 ≈ 800M tokens/day -> $9,200/day @ $11.50/1M
- 300 tokens avg -> ~533M tokens/day -> $6,130/day
- 750 tokens avg -> ~1.33B tokens/day -> $15,295/day

Operational notes / MAP actions for accuracy:
- We need a 2-hour load-sim window from CloverTech with representative prompt sequences so our sim matches real prompt length distribution.
- Work with your engineering team to flag the 10% batch window (nightly) so we can test batching savings end-to-end.
- Redwood will provide a one-pager that breaks down tokens/$ across model variants + savings from prefix caching vs. no-cache; will attach before the Thu call.

I've uploaded a draft MAP to HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deals/CLV-153 (please let me know if you need different visibility).

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer, Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Thanks Karthik — that's very helpful. Two quick asks prior to Thu:
1) Procurement would like a short estimate table (1-pager) that shows tokens/$ broken down for: baseline (hosted), 1-year commitment (Dedicated), and quantized variant (if applicable). Can you include both per-1M and monthlyized projected spend for the eval period?
2) Could Redwood confirm whether prefix caching reduces billed tokens before or after model compression in your billing model? Finance wants clarity for internal cost comparisons.

Also sharing a placeholder DocuSign here for paperwork routing; it's not the SOW but will help our legal queue: https://docusign.com/CLV-153-placeholder

Alicia
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Moore <am@clovertech.com>, John Patel <john.patel@clovertech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-08T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: finalizing unit-econ checks & handoff for CloverTech

Alicia —

Attached is the one-pager and an updated MAP PDF (map-final-onepager.pdf) that includes the per-1M token table plus a monthlyized projection for the 2-week eval window and a conservative production run. Short answers to your procurement questions: prefix caching reduces billed tokens before billing normalization — i.e., cached tokens are not sent to the runtime and are therefore excluded from billed token counts; compression/quantization affects runtime ME and GPU cost but billing is based on tokens the runtime executes. We'll add a short note in the MAP for clarity.

Next steps:
- Thu 6/7 11:00am PT alignment (calendar invite sent) — confirm prompt samples and load-sim window
- Redwoods to deliver final MAP + token-econ sheet by EOD Thu (we've attached the first draft)
- CloverTech procurement to circulate placeholder DocuSign to Legal; we'll be ready for SOW redlines the week of 6/17

Attachments: map-final-onepager.pdf, clv-map-token-econ-sheet.xlsx

See you on the call.

—Sergio
